decisions.name: Duplicate analysis
decisions.question: Does the same item appear in more than one row?
decisions.label: Treat rows with matching titles as one item
decisions.reason: A person answered: Treat rows with matching titles as one item.

decisions.name: Train/test split
decisions.question: How are rows divided into training and test so the score is fair?
decisions.label: Keep each item's rows on one side
decisions.reason: Rows of one item stay on one side, so no item is scored on rows the model saw.

promises.promise: No item has rows in both train and test.
promises.detail: The split, or a step before it, changed since this was checked. Last time: No item is in both sides (332 train, 83 test items).
